name: DIUTURNAL MANTLES
text: When an operative shoots a friendly Voidscarred with a Blast or Torrent weapon, the defender may re-roll one defence die. Friendly Voidscarreds also ignore the damage of x-inch Devastating unless they are the target of the sequence.

name: MISTFIELD
text: Once per turning point, as a defence roll begins against a friendly Voidscarred shot from more than 3 inches away: until the sequence ends the weapon's Piercing x is 1 lower (Piercing 1 is lost).

name: RUNES OF GUIDANCE
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Way Seeker or Soul Weaver uses a PSYCHIC unique action other than Warp Fold, its distance requirement is 3 inches longer until the action ends (6 becomes 9). PSYCHIC weapons are not affected.

name: STAR CHARTS
text: Strategic gambit: a D3 that beats the current turning point number earns 1 CP and retires the charts for the battle; a miss may be tried again in a later turning point.
